verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses virtualization support, hypervisor compatibility (Hyper-V, WSL2, etc.), or Docker/container workflows on Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme; the material only covers CPU/NPU specs and on-device AI SDKs. This is a fair question for a laptop-class silicon platform where WoA developers would care about VM/container support, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
